stem: Simon needs to respond to an argument he has suggested that people will make. Which of the following could come after sentence 32 and best accomplish this goal?

options.label: F
options.text: With that said, it wouldn’t be fair to ask bicyclists to pay to use the roadways.

options.label: G
options.text: Bicyclists just want a place to be certain that they can ride on the roads safely.

options.label: H
options.text: Bikes don’t create potholes, and they don’t leave grease and gas marks.

options.label: J
options.text: This is true, so I would suggest that bike fees be significantly lower than automobile fees.
